# Sentinel Fortune LLC

> {{ site.description }}

Sentinel Fortune LLC publishes operational systems and practical tools for small
businesses. Public content covers how those systems work and where their limits
are. Products are sold as downloadable digital packages.

## Editorial position

All published guidance is operational and general. It is not legal, financial,
HR, safety, code, permit, or regulatory advice. Where a topic touches a licensed
trade decision — pricing, code compliance, permit requirements, safety
determinations — the content routes it to a qualified human rather than
answering it.
